messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up: pen test intake for next week. Need to align RBAC hotfix runway + observability gates before the retest. Quick sync?
Maria Ortiz: Yep. What's our current risk heatmap? any high-risk assets we should prioritize?
Samir Patel: Triage notes: exposed admin endpoint /admin/api (HIGH), KMS proxy creds not rotated (MED-HIGH), debug logging off on inference-gateway (LOW-MED). I added these to the tracker.
Jordan Lee: Tracker link: https://redwood.internal/pt/track/8742 — see tabs: Risk, Mitigations, Evidence.
Alex Chen: Plan proposal: (1) pre-stage RBAC change in staging canary (role scope reduction), (2) enable debug-level audit streaming for inference-gateway for 6h, (3) rotate KMS proxy creds in a timeboxed window, (4) collect pre/post audit queries.
Maria Ortiz: I can open the RBAC PR + smoke tests today. cc @ops-bot can you reserve a 2h maintenance slot Tue 03:00 UTC for the credential rotation?
ops-bot: ops-bot: Maintenance window scheduled Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC. Alerting to oncall and posting to #release-war-room.
Samir Patel: Audit query to gather relevant KMS access (paste below)
```
SELECT * FROM audit_logs
WHERE resource = "kms/key-inference-proxy"
  AND action IN ("Decrypt","GenerateDataKey","Encrypt")
  AND timestamp >= '2025-03-01T00:00:00Z'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 200
```
Maria Ortiz: Good. I'll include that query in the evidence pack and run it before/after rotate. Also adding smoke tests: 
- role-reduced user cannot call /admin/api 
- inference requests still pass under canary routing 
- KMS decrypt latency within SLA

Jordan Lee: Add mitigation id M-5023 to the intake. For retest coordination: once PR merged, do canary in dedicated pool (5% traffic) for 1h, then escalate. If regressions, automatic rollback.
Samir Patel: Uploading pre-rotation logs to readroom now, presigned link will be in the tracker.
Alex Chen: Great. Ownership: Maria = RBAC PR + tests, Samir = evidence + logs, Jordan = ops scheduling + canary gates. I'll own the retest liaison with the assessor.
Maria Ortiz: Will update tracker and ping the assessor with the new evidence timeline. Expect PR by EOD.
Jordan Lee: Also a quick note — add an observability gate: require audit export to S3 and an alert if KMS access spikes > 3x baseline within 30m during/after rotate.
Samir Patel: Will wire the alert rule. Query for baseline spikes: 
`rate(count_over_time(audit_kms_access_total[30m]))`
Maria Ortiz: Thanks team. tagging for handoff: @Samir Patel @Jordan Lee :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Thanks. We'll reconvene after PR is posted to confirm times.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Oncall notified: @oncall-night (Samir Patel)
